clearance_requests_scope_check.name: clearance_requests_scope_check
clearance_requests_scope_check.value: ("clearance_requests"."scope" = 'channel' and "clearance_requests"."licensed_channel_id" is not null and "clearance_requests"."licensed_video_id" is null) or ("clearance_requests"."scope" = 'video' and "clearance_requests"."licensed_video_id" is not null and "clearance_requests"."licensed_channel_id" is null)

licenses_revoked_check.name: licenses_revoked_check
licenses_revoked_check.value: ("licenses"."status" = 'revoked') = ("licenses"."revoked_reason" is not null and "licenses"."revoked_at" is not null)
